description: This file defines the UserRepository class which manages database operations related to User entities, including CRUD operations and queries by various user attributes.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing User data in the database, providing methods for CRUD operations and specific queries.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all user records from the database.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a user by their unique ID.

methods.name: findBySubjectId
methods.description: Finds a user by their subject ID.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a base SQL SELECT query builder for user data.

methods.name: findByUsername
methods.description: Finds an active user by username.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a user by their ID.

methods.name: deleteByIds
methods.description: Deletes multiple users by their IDs.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database.

methods.name: findByProjectId
methods.description: Finds users associated with a specific project ID.

methods.name: updateById
methods.description: Updates user data by user ID.
